subject: Show the fire tab's land cover year by year
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-06/07 that the Brand — Kårbölebranden tab shows TESSERA R4 land-cover maps for 2017–2025 with a year selector (rendered on ICE by task 0151, run 20261107T180605Z-6abfb7bd684b; 2025 uses HR-VPP 2024, labelled), keeps NMD 2018 as the pre-fire baseline and adds NMD 2023 with its own classes for comparison, with notes that the 2018 map contains the fire and that the forestry, height, soil-moisture and DEM layers are the same every year. Not in scope: the other tabs' NMD 2023 layers (separate task), Prithvi (unpublished until the paper). Review: fresh Claude reviewer; integration needs Tobias's reviewer=human line.
